text.p: Chelsea Village Plc, the company that controls F.A. cup finalists Chelsea, has paid a "modest" sum to acquire the venerable Football Monthly magazine, it said on Tuesday.
"We are delighted to have Football Monthly as part of our overall media strategy," said Chelsea Village company secretary Alan Shaw in a statement.

The company has also recruited Paul Hawksbee from IPC Magazines and appointed him head of media. Hawksbee, who was editor in chief of IPC's five soccer titles, will be asked to oversee Chelsea's media strategy and reestablish Football Monthly as a major title.
The magazine was launched in 1951 and at its peak sold 250,000 copies. But circulation has since fallen to around 10,000 and it has been struggling for survival.
